title: The brain keeps selecting subscriptions.activity_name (UndefinedColumn)
text_en: Six failed queries in seven days select activity_name from subscriptions. The column exists on activities, not on subscriptions. The Guessed-to-real table in records-schema.md documents 'activities.name to activity_name', which reads as if the column is simply named activity_name and invites the wrong join.

prompt.conclusion: The fixture demonstrates a concrete failure in the reported workflow.
prompt.repro: Open the cited run and inspect its first failing step.
prompt.change: Update the demonstrated rule in the target checkout and add a regression case for the observed input.
prompt.done_when: The regression case reproduces the failure before the change and passes after it.
